lessons.title: A C program, from zero
objectives: A C program is source text that a compiler translates into an executable program.
body: A C program is source text that a compiler translates into an executable program. Compilation checks language rules; executing the resulting program performs its instructions. A successful compilation does not prove your algorithm is correct.

#include <stdio.h> makes standard input/output declarations available. int main(void) is the entry point. Braces group statements, and a semicolon ends most statements. printf writes output; \n inside a string means a newline.

A declaration such as int score = 10 creates an integer variable and initializes it. score = score + 7 computes the right side using the old value, then stores the result. C names are case-sensitive. Read from initialized variables only.

Use +, -, *, /, and % for arithmetic. Integer division truncates toward zero, so 7 / 2 is 3. Unlike Python’s unbounded integers, C integers have finite ranges. Signed overflow is undefined behavior: choose types and bounds deliberately.

checks.q: What value is printed?
checks.why: 10 + 7 is assigned back to score.

checks.q: What is integer 7 / 2 in C?
checks.why: Integer division truncates toward zero.

recall_cards.q: What happens before a C program runs?
recall_cards.a: Its source is compiled into an executable.

recall_cards.q: Why is signed integer overflow dangerous in C?
recall_cards.a: It is undefined behavior, not guaranteed wraparound.

lessons.title: Read and print exact values
objectives: Formatted input in C connects a format string to addresses where values will be stored.
body: Formatted input in C connects a format string to addresses where values will be stored. scanf("%d", &n) reads an int into n. The & operator supplies its address. Missing it for a scalar is a serious bug.

Use %d with int and %lld with long long. The declared type and format must agree. scanf returns the number of successful conversions; check it before using the variables. Whitespace between numeric input values can be spaces or newlines.

printf uses the same integer format names to display values, but receives the values, not their addresses. Print exactly what the judge requests. Extra prompts and debug messages make otherwise correct output wrong.

For input-heavy contests, buffered scanf/printf are a reasonable starting point. A custom parser is a later optimization, after correctness and profiling. In C, line-based text input can use fgets with a buffer size; never use removed, unsafe gets.

checks.q: How many successful conversions should reading two integers return?
checks.why: Each parsed integer counts as one conversion.

checks.q: For an int n, does scanf need n or &n?
checks.why: scanf needs the address where it will store the value.

recall_cards.q: Which format matches long long?
recall_cards.a: %lld

recall_cards.q: Why check scanf’s return value?
recall_cards.a: To avoid using variables when expected input was not successfully read.

lessons.title: Decisions and loops in C
objectives: Comparisons such as n >= 0 produce a truth value.
body: Comparisons such as n >= 0 produce a truth value. if executes its block for a nonzero condition; else handles the remaining case. Equality uses ==, while = assigns. Use braces even when a block has one statement.
Combine conditions with && for and, || for or, and ! for not. The expression n % 2 == 0 tests evenness. && and || short-circuit, so the second condition runs only if it is needed.

for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) initializes i once, checks the condition before each iteration, and increments after the body. A while loop repeats while its condition holds. Make sure the state progresses toward stopping.

Initialize an accumulator before the loop that uses it. Reset it between independent test cases. Trace the smallest allowed case and exact thresholds; off-by-one errors do not disappear when you change programming languages.

checks.q: How many even numbers from 1 through 10 are counted?
Which compares equality: = or ==?
checks.why: A single equals sign is assignment.

recall_cards.q: How is logical and written in C?
Where do you initialize an accumulator?
recall_cards.a: Before its accumulating loop, and separately for each independent case.

lessons.title: Arrays and null-terminated strings
objectives: An array stores a fixed number of same-type elements contiguously.
body: An array stores a fixed number of same-type elements contiguously. int a[3] = {4, 8, 2} has valid indices 0, 1, 2. C does not automatically check an array index. Reading or writing outside the array is undefined behavior.

The expression sizeof(a) / sizeof(a[0]) can count elements when a is an actual array in the current scope. It does not recover the length from a pointer or from an array parameter inside a function. Pass lengths explicitly.

A C string is a character sequence ending in a zero byte, written \0. A buffer must include space for that terminator. char word[8] can hold at most seven ordinary characters plus the terminator. Use scanf("%7s", word) for one whitespace-delimited word in that buffer.

For text that may contain spaces, use fgets(buffer, sizeof buffer, stdin), and account for the newline it may retain. Arrays are not assignable as whole values in C. Use loops or appropriate library operations to copy their elements.

checks.q: What is the last valid index in an array of length 3?
checks.why: Indices start at zero.

checks.q: How many ordinary characters fit in char word[8] as a terminated string?
checks.why: One byte is reserved for the null terminator.

recall_cards.q: Does C automatically check array bounds?
recall_cards.a: No. You must keep indices within the allocated range.

recall_cards.q: What marks the end of a C string?
recall_cards.a: A zero byte, written \0.

lessons.title: Functions, addresses, and pointers
objectives: A function packages instructions behind a name, parameters, and a return type.
body: A function packages instructions behind a name, parameters, and a return type. Parameters are passed by value in C: changing an ordinary parameter does not change the caller’s variable.

A pointer stores an address. In int *p = &x, &x is x’s address and *p accesses the int at that address. Only dereference a pointer that points to a live, suitable object. A null or dangling pointer is not usable storage.

Pass a pointer when a function must modify the caller’s object. Arrays passed to functions are represented through pointers; the function needs a separate length argument. const int *a promises not to modify elements through that pointer.

A local automatic variable stops existing when its block ends. Returning its address creates a dangling pointer. Prefer returning a value, modifying caller-owned storage, or using explicitly managed allocation with a clear owner.

checks.q: What is x after add_one(&x) when x starts at 4?
checks.why: The function changes the object at x’s address.

checks.q: Does *p mean address-of or dereference?
checks.why: It accesses the pointed-to object.

recall_cards.q: How do you obtain x’s address?
recall_cards.a: &x

recall_cards.q: Why must you not return the address of an automatic local variable?
recall_cards.a: Its lifetime ends when the function exits, leaving a dangling pointer.

lessons.title: Allocate, bound, and release memory
objectives: When an array length is only known at runtime, dynamically allocated storage can hold its elements.
body: When an array length is only known at runtime, dynamically allocated storage can hold its elements. malloc returns a pointer or NULL if allocation fails. Include stdlib.h, check for failure, and release the allocation exactly once with free.
Compute allocation sizes without overflow. Check n <= SIZE_MAX / sizeof *a before requesting n * sizeof *a bytes. Validate signed inputs before converting them to size_t, which is unsigned.

free ends the allocation’s lifetime. Do not read or write through the old pointer afterward, and do not free it again. A pointer assignment copies an address, not the allocation. Decide which part of your program owns the storage.

For debugging your own code locally, compiler warnings and address/undefined-behavior sanitizers can expose mistakes. They are debugging tools, not an untrusted-code sandbox. For C++ contests, vector usually makes ownership simpler than manual malloc/free.

checks.q: Which function releases malloc-allocated storage?
checks.why: Each successful allocation needs a clear owner that releases it once.

checks.q: Is it valid to read an allocation after free? Answer yes or no.
checks.why: The allocated object’s lifetime has ended.

recall_cards.q: What must you check before allocating n elements?
recall_cards.a: That the byte-count multiplication cannot overflow and that allocation succeeds.

recall_cards.q: What does copying a pointer copy?
recall_cards.a: The address, not the pointed-to allocation.

lessons.title: Your first C++17 program
objectives: C++ source is compiled before execution.
body: C++ source is compiled before execution. A compiler translates valid source into a program; it cannot prove that the program solves your problem. Compile errors, runtime errors, and wrong answers are different kinds of feedback.

#include <iostream> declares stream input and output. int main() is the entry point. Braces group statements and semicolons end most statements. std::cout writes values with <<. The character literal '\n' writes a newline.
Declare a variable with a type: int score = 10. Assignment stores a value; == compares two values. long long is useful for larger sums, but it is still bounded. Signed overflow is undefined behavior.
Use explicit initialization. The compiler will not safely invent a value for an uninitialized local integer. Predict the result of each line, then compile and run a small complete program.

checks.q: What value is printed?
checks.why: The variable increases from 10 to 17.

checks.q: Does compilation alone prove that your algorithm is correct? Answer yes or no.
checks.why: It checks language rules, not whether you solved the task.

lessons.title: C++ input and output
objectives: std::cin >> a >> b reads two whitespace-separated values into existing variables.
body: std::cin >> a >> b reads two whitespace-separated values into existing variables. The operator selects conversions from their declared types. Test the stream result before using values when input might be missing.

For ordinary batch contests, call std::ios::sync_with_stdio(false) and std::cin.tie(nullptr) before I/O. These disable C/C++ stream synchronization and remove cin’s automatic tie to cout. Avoid mixing scanf/printf with unsynchronized cin/cout.
Use '\n' for ordinary newlines. std::endl also flushes the output buffer. Interactive problems need explicit flushing before you wait for the judge; optimization must not break the protocol.

Use std::getline for a whole text line. Numeric extraction can leave a newline waiting, so reason about that transition. Do not print prompts or assume an initial test-case count unless the statement specifies one.

checks.q: What extra action does std::endl perform after a newline?
checks.why: It flushes the output stream.

checks.q: For input 7 12, what sum is printed?
checks.why: Both extracted integers are added.

recall_cards.q: What does cin.tie(nullptr) remove?
recall_cards.a: The tied output stream that would otherwise be flushed before input operations.

recall_cards.q: When must you explicitly flush output?
recall_cards.a: When an interactive protocol needs to receive your query before replying.

lessons.title: Conditions and loops
objectives: Use if, else if, and else to select a block.
body: Use if, else if, and else to select a block. Comparisons use ==, !=, <, <=, >, >=. Combine conditions with &&, ||, and !. A nonzero scalar condition is treated as true.
A for loop has initialization, condition, and update sections. for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) visits zero through n - 1. The check happens before the body, so n = 0 gives no iterations.
A while loop repeats while its condition holds. Make progress toward stopping. break exits the nearest loop; continue skips to its next iteration. Braces make the boundaries of blocks explicit.
Counters and sums must be initialized before accumulating. Reset them for each independent test case. Test a condition exactly at its threshold as well as on each side.

checks.q: What is the sum from 1 through 4?
How many iterations does for (int i=0; i<3; ++i) perform?
checks.why: It visits 0, 1, and 2.

recall_cards.q: What is the distinction between i < n and i <= n in a zero-based loop?
recall_cards.a: The latter includes n and may access beyond an n-element sequence.

recall_cards.q: What keeps a while loop from running forever?
recall_cards.a: A state change that eventually makes its condition false.

lessons.title: Functions, references, and const
objectives: Functions name a computation.
body: Functions name a computation. int add(int a, int b) receives copies of two integers and returns an integer. return sends a value to the caller; printing merely displays output.

A reference parameter such as int& x refers to the caller’s object. Updating x changes that object. Pass a large read-only structure as const T& to avoid copying while preventing modification through that reference.
const communicates a restriction on modification. auto asks the compiler to deduce a type from an initializer; it does not mean that the variable can dynamically change type like a Python name.

An object’s lifetime matters. Do not return a reference or pointer to an automatic local variable. Avoid unnecessary copies in a loop, but also avoid retaining references that a later container operation may invalidate.

checks.q: What does x become in this program?
checks.why: The reference parameter modifies the caller’s x.

checks.q: For a large read-only object, prefer a copy or const reference?
checks.why: A const reference avoids the copy and prevents modification through it.

recall_cards.q: How is int x different from int& x as a parameter?
recall_cards.a: The first is a copy; the second refers to the caller’s object.

recall_cards.q: What does auto do?
recall_cards.a: It deduces a fixed compile-time type from the initializer.

lessons.title: Vectors and strings
objectives: std::vector<T> is a resizable contiguous sequence.
body: std::vector<T> is a resizable contiguous sequence. std::vector<int> a{4, 8, 2} has three elements. Indices start at zero; a.size() gives the number of elements. Indexing with [] does not automatically check bounds.

push_back appends. A range-for loop visits elements: for (int x : a) copies each int; for (auto& x : a) allows modifications. reserve increases capacity without creating elements, while resize changes the number of elements.

std::string manages a sequence of characters. Use .size(), indexing, concatenation, and standard algorithms rather than manually reserving a null terminator as with a raw C character buffer. cin >> word reads a whitespace-delimited word; getline reads a line.

A vector append may reallocate its storage and invalidate references and iterators. Do not keep an iterator across an operation that might invalidate it. For nested vectors, each inner vector has its own size and allocation.

checks.q: What is the sum after appending 5?
Does reserve(10) create ten elements? Answer yes or no.
checks.why: It changes capacity, not size.

recall_cards.q: What is the difference between reserve and resize?
recall_cards.a: reserve provides capacity; resize changes the actual number of elements.

recall_cards.q: Why can push_back invalidate a reference?
recall_cards.a: It may move the vector’s elements into a newly allocated buffer.

lessons.title: Types, cost, and contest constraints
objectives: Big-O describes how work grows with input size.
body: Big-O describes how work grows with input size. One complete scan is O(n); all ordered pairs usually require O(n²). Two consecutive scans still take O(n), whereas two full nested scans take O(n²).

A problem with n = 200,000 usually rules out a straightforward quadratic scan under normal contest limits. Faster syntax cannot fix an unsuitable growth rate. Estimate both the number of operations and extra memory.

Widen arithmetic before it overflows: 1LL * a * b evaluates the product in long long when a and b are ints. long long answer = a * b can overflow in the int expression before assignment. All intermediate values still need to fit.

Prefer using aliases and constexpr constants to broad macros. #define int long long rewrites tokens throughout your program and hides types. A macro can evaluate an argument multiple times. A function has clearer type and evaluation rules.

checks.q: What is the product of 100000 and 100000?
checks.why: It exceeds a typical signed 32-bit int range.

checks.q: Two full nested n-element loops have O(n) or O(n^2) growth?
checks.why: Each of n outer visits has n inner visits.

recall_cards.q: Why does assigning a*b to long long not always prevent overflow?
recall_cards.a: a*b can be computed in int before the result is assigned.

recall_cards.q: What is preferable to #define int long long?
recall_cards.a: An explicit long long declaration or a using alias such as using i64 = long long.
